paper_position.frozen_thesis: AV-TRACE tests long-video audiovisual reliability with human-adjudicated source-disjoint matched episode families that hold the question, evidence graph, backend, and budget fixed while changing evidence-route availability; it diagnoses whether answer accuracy and retrieval recall conceal failures of acquisition, support, citation, insufficiency diagnosis, stopping, and recovery across strong learned baselines.

controller_findings.interpretation: Syntax factorization improved output validity and action selection in some settings, but semantic public-state estimation and terminal behavior remain below frozen competence gates. These findings motivate a benchmark-first pivot and do not establish a controller method contribution.
controller_findings.comparison_warning: Task-120 v2 and Task-121 v3 used different suites; their aggregates are descriptive and are not a paired improvement estimate.

retained_current.claim: Audited matched C/B/R execution and replay infrastructure exists.
Restoration uses a common supported-answer endpoint.
Final-point route certificates operationalize premature stopping.
Pinned learned modality retrieval and fixed no-training fusion are reproducible.

retained_gated.claim: AV-TRACE provides a human-adjudicated source-disjoint matched intervention benchmark.
Answer correctness and supported-answer correctness diverge on held-out H2 families.
AV-TRACE separates at least two non-retrieval failure stages across multiple source groups.
Common-endpoint restoration and no-trigger controls measure recovery separately from diagnosis.

secondary_only: Generic learned retrieval is not automatically beneficial.
Full-timeline retrieval is harder than shortlisted retrieval.
Explicit sufficiency control differs from or outperforms ReAct.
Modality necessity outside individually H2-validated families and adequately sourced strata.
dropped: Controller v2 or v3 is the paper's novel proposed method.
Current controller findings demonstrate learned-agent recovery.
Syntax validity implies semantic controller competence.
Current NOAA families form a validated benchmark or primary test set.
Current machine-provisional SES, necessity, or modality labels are human gold.
Broad first, unique, SOTA, universal reliability, population-ranking, or out-of-domain generalization claims.

fairness_contract: Same backbone for learned ReAct and learned sufficiency where practical.
Same backend, candidate universe, tools, grounded finalizer, budget, repair policy, and failure handling.
No deterministic controller is called a learned baseline.
A text-only controller cannot substitute for the required direct audiovisual baseline.

gates.name: MINI_PILOT_INPUT_READY

Affirmative processing and annotation authority for every source.

A required pilot stratum cannot be sampled and no narrower claim is frozen before review.

gates.name: CONSTRUCT_VALIDITY_MINI_PILOT_GO
go: 12 of 12 families complete across the 6 frozen source groups.
Every required role and adjudication complete.
At least 9 of 12 families reach H1.
At least 8 of 12 families reach H2.
Pair-isolation failures are at most 1 of 12.
No unresolved critical governance hold.
Systematic minimality or modality failure affects no more than 3 of 12.
At least 2 accepted source groups are outside the current NOAA lineage.
At least 1 ambient and 1 V+S+A family reach H2, or those strata are removed from the planned paper.
Saturation audit finds no new unblocked accepted route, or every discovery is repaired and re-audited.
Observed labor and H2 yield support an unchanged-criteria route to 60 H2.
repair: At least 5 of 12 families reach H1, or failures are localized to repairable wording, interval, route, role, form, or source defects.
No evidence shows that the central SES, necessity, and intervention construct is unreviewable.
no_go: Fewer than 5 of 12 families reach H1.
At least 6 of 12 families are rejected.
Systematic alternative-support, minimality, necessity, intervention-isolation, or governance failures undermine the construct.
The intended data cannot be used under required rights or privacy rules.

gates.name: LEARNED_CONTROLLER_READY
go: Every go_threshold passes on one frozen unseen fictional suite.
The run and independent audit are hash-bound and fail closed.
No prohibited development source, evaluation family, or evaluator-private label is accessed.
repair: Syntax and safety pass but one or more semantic floors fail.
Repair is confined to consumed synthetic or development data and does not change future labels, gates, or test content.
no_go: A second frozen unseen suite after repair still fails a semantic floor.
Evaluator leakage, post-output tuning, deterministic substitution, or controller-state-to-answer mapping occurs.
Competence requires oracle or evaluation-private information.
prohibited_tuning_sources: Task-120 restricted labels or per-case evaluation content

gates.name: END_TO_END_DIAGNOSTIC_GO
go: Learned single-shot RAG, learned ReAct, and learned sufficiency control complete under frozen common contracts.
Complete C/B/R and no-trigger accounting is independently replayed.
At least 1 intervention-aware separation occurs across at least 3 source groups and is not wholly attributable to one family.
At least 1 H2 case separates answer correctness from supported-answer correctness or citation validity.
At least 2 non-retrieval failure categories occur, each on at least 2 source groups.
Source-level denominators and complete invalid-run accounting are reported.
A directional ReAct-versus-sufficiency claim uses a 0.10 absolute CLEAN supported-answer non-inferiority margin.
A directional controller claim requires at least 0.15 absolute improvement in BLOCKED false sufficiency, premature stopping, or common-endpoint restoration.
repair: Construct and controller gates pass but the low-N diagnostic is inconclusive.
A typed execution defect or source-coverage shortfall is repairable without outcome-based family replacement or evaluator leakage.
no_go: Human-valid intervention isolation or leakage closure fails.
All apparent differences are explained by retrieval recall or metric artifacts.
No answer-versus-support or citation divergence appears.
No non-retrieval failure-stage separation survives audit.
A valid strong learned baseline cannot execute without evaluator-private assistance.

gates.name: FIRST_40_SCALED_REVIEWS_AUTHORIZED
go: A frozen pool of 120 to 160 P-tier candidates from 30 to 40 source groups exists.
At least 25 rights-eligible source groups are available for the 20-source target plus a 25 percent reserve.
Source-disjoint development, validation, and test rules are frozen.
Staffing, labor, compute, storage, and rights-review capacity are approved.
No construct threshold is relaxed.
repair: Scientific gates pass but candidate, rights, reserve, staffing, or budget capacity is incomplete and repairable without changing the construct.
no_go: Any prerequisite gate is NO_GO.
The pool or reserve can be reached only by weaker construct, rights, privacy, or split rules.

gates.name: FULL_60_H2_PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED
go: Observed H2 yield after the first 40 reviews is at least 60 percent.
Acceptance does not require weakening SES, necessity, modality, or pair-isolation rules.
Every high-risk stratum has at least 5 completed reviews.
Measured source preparation, annotation labor, rights throughput, compute, and storage fit the remaining schedule and budget.
The rights-eligible reserve remains at least 25 percent.
The frozen route still reaches 60 H2 families from at least 20 source groups.
repair: Yield or throughput misses a floor for a localized versionable reason that can be rerun without test-outcome use or weaker acceptance.
no_go: H2 yield is below 60 percent without a localized repair.
Rights, labor, source diversity, or reviewer capacity makes 60 H2 infeasible.
A required stratum cannot be filled under unchanged H2 rules.
The principal diagnostic conclusion no longer supports the benchmark thesis.

gates.name: 60_H2_CORPUS_FREEZE
go: 60 H2 families from at least 20 source groups.
Source split is at least 8 development, 4 validation, and 8 untouched test source groups with target family split 24, 12, and 24.
Complete rights decisions and no applicable unknown_hold.
At least 25 percent source and family reserve for rights failure, withdrawal, or construct defect.
Frozen prompts, models, retrieval, budgets, metrics, practical thresholds, invalid-run reserve, and release scope.
No weakened construct criteria and no test-source tuning.
repair: The authorized production wave is scientifically valid but has fewer than 60 H2 families, fewer than 20 eligible source groups, an underfilled composition stratum, or an incomplete non-critical rights or release record.
The deficit can be filled from the frozen reserve or a new rights-first source wave without changing test outcomes, construct thresholds, or split rules.
no_go: The 60 H2 or 20 source-group minima cannot be reached without weaker construct or governance rules.
Test privacy or source disjointness has been broken.
A critical rights, leakage, pair-isolation, or construct defect affects the frozen core and cannot be repaired from the reserve.
Required source or domain composition remains infeasible.

gates.name: PAPER_CLAIM_READY
go: Gate F and every prior scientific gate are GO.
At least four preregistered learned system classes and at least two backbone or model families are complete.
Source-cluster uncertainty, source and domain leave-out sensitivity, required ablations, costs, invalid runs, denominators, and negative or null strata are complete.
The principal finding survives retrieval, capacity, modality, prompt, trigger, metric, and source sensitivity.
Independent metric, replay, leakage, rights or release, novelty, and sentence-level claim audits pass.
Every abstract and conclusion statement maps to a frozen result and uses the approved release boundary.
repair: The benchmark and main evaluation remain valid, but a non-critical missing baseline, ablation, audit, uncertainty analysis, or wording defect prevents a complete claim package.
Repair does not permit rerunning the locked test set to select a favorable result.
no_go: The core matched-intervention construct or causal isolation fails.
The principal result is explained by one source, one domain, retrieval alone, evaluator leakage, or an invalid metric.
Strong baselines or source-level inference are absent.
Release wording exceeds actual rights.
An unsupported headline claim remains after audit.
